dct_description_sm: An accurate survey of the boundaries of the Delaware Indian Lands in northeastern Kansas. The map also indicates Indian and English names of rivers, identifies "Cant (i.e. Cantonment) Leavenworth" on the Missouri River, and locates the "Kanzas Village," "Reservations for Half Breed Kansas," "La Plume's House," "Kanzas Agency," and "Agriculturist's House," all situated along the Kanzas (Kansas) River.

An accurate survey of the boundaries of the Delaware Indian Lands in northeastern Kansas. The map also indicates Indian and English names of rivers, identifies "Cant (i.e. Cantonment) Leavenworth" on the Missouri River, and locates the "Kanzas Village," "Reservations for Half Breed Kansas," "La Plume's House," "Kanzas Agency," and "Agriculturist's House," all situated along the Kanzas (Kansas) River. Oriented with north to the bottom. Pen-and-ink, mounted on cloth. Annotated in ink: "Office of the Chief of Engineers, Washington Oct 6th 1875. Copy sent to Maj. Weitzel, Corps of Engrs with Dept. letter of this date." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. vcFY24
